svg.text: Shift Happens Uploader - daily user flow

g.text: 1. One-time setup: the channel owner signs in with Google and grants upload + comment access to their own channel.
2. Every morning: read the top comments of yesterday's episode and pick the most-liked "A" or "B" vote.
3. Write and render the next animated episode that continues the story with the winning choice.
4. Upload it to the owner's channel (public, not made for kids) and post "Comment A or B" on it.
5. Viewers watch and vote in the comments; the cycle repeats the next day. About 1 upload per day.

svg.text: No third-party users, no data sharing. The only API user is the channel owner.
